summary: Tube is a self-hosted video sharing application written in Go that provides a platform for uploading and distributing media. It includes built-in transcoding to MP4 H.265 AAC, support for multiple collections, and generated RSS feeds for content syndication.
goodFor: It is a suitable option if you want a lightweight, standalone video platform with automated transcoding capabilities without the bloat of mainstream streaming services.
watchOut: The project has no tagged releases and zero recorded recent commits, indicating that it may be an abandoned or very early-stage experiment lacking active maintenance.
deployNotes: As a Go binary, it typically compiles down to a single executable file that requires persistent storage for media files and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
